general definition of generation x aside from it being regarded a the generation that followed baby boomer it s important to point out there is no root definition for this term a well since the theme of this work is centered on identifying the reality and misconception of young african american culture i have chosen a definition that incorporates all of the component that were part of my birth childhood and young adult life taken from a web site entitled generation x created and maintained by the colorado college the definition is a follows we are a group of people born between NUM and NUM we are individual who live for the here and now like to experiment and who require immediate result we are typically selfish and cynical and depend a lot on our parent we question authority and feel like we carry the burden of the previous generation it s that simple it seems we have come to be called xer s simply because we represent something negative to our elder we may be the one thing all of generation will be called upon to look after our parent knowing they failed to look after u intergenerational justice failed somewhere along the way and it will be our task to either rectify it or these bleak prospect along with the fact that we will be forced to support the largest amount of senior citizen ever do not provide much hope some believe that these blockade will be too much for u to handle and we will for the most part fail at life but many see our individualism and resourcefulness that ha been built up through our childhood a our savior we will soon discover who is right and who and applies them to all those who were born within the corresponding year when in fact these similarity speak primarily to only white issue and concern for instance they say we depend a lot on our separate generation xer s black and white occupant would eventually be identified i never knew i would be the one doing it extracting the black from generation x and categorizing it for it own sake is a necessary and important contingency without doing so the social ill that plague ghetto america would be lost within the generality that are explained away a part of a collective american identity their content there is far too much negativity thriving within our culture there must be acknowledgment and accountability for the truth whether good or bad i am aware that not all of u have succumbed
